topic: FastAPI OpenAPI Contract & Mobile Client Generation Strategy

networking_architecture.kmp_networking_verdict: REJECTED. Networking is NOT placed in KMP. Putting Ktor in KMP adds unnecessary multiplatform engine configuration, fragile iOS background session handling, and thread isolation complexity.
networking_architecture.android_client: Retrofit 2.11 + OkHttp with kotlinx.serialization. Native Android coroutines and NetworkCallback.
networking_architecture.ios_client: URLSession async/await with native Swift Codable. Native NWPathMonitor for network state.
networking_architecture.dto_strategy: Code generation via openapi-generator or tailored typed DTOs matching backend Pydantic schemas. Zero manual synchronization drift.
